turns.q: Do you need photos, and where do I send them?
turns.replyTail:
Yes. Please send clear photos showing the damage, the item and its packaging by email to hello@tediber.com. Include your order number, a short description of the issue and, if possible, any reservations noted on the delivery note.

Delivery damage must be reported within 72 hours of delivery.

turns.replyTail:
The return fees for a change-of-mind return do not apply to a damaged item. I can’t confirm whether you would have to pay anything until the damage has been assessed.

Please email hello@tediber.com with your order number, a short description of the damage, clear photos of the item and packaging, and the country from which the item would be returned. You will then receive the appropriate return instructions for your case.

turns.q: What if more than one item in my order is affected?
turns.replyTail:
If more than one item is affected, please list each item separately in your email and include a clear description and photos or videos showing each issue, along with photos of the packaging where relevant. Include your order number and send everything to hello@tediber.com.

Delivery damage must be reported within 72 hours of delivery. Each affected item will be assessed from the information provided.

turns.q: What if the replacement is also damaged?
turns.replyTail:
If the replacement also arrives damaged, please report it as soon as possible with clear photos of the replacement, its packaging and the damage. Include your order number and any reservations noted on the delivery note, then email everything to hello@tediber.com within 72 hours of delivery.

Please do not send the replacement back on your own. Any further replacement or refund would need to be assessed from the evidence provided.
